operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single **package credit type** by id.

A package credit type links a credit type to a package and carries the credit `amount` granted for that package. The record id is supplied in the path; the response is the flat record (`id`, `credit_type_id`, `package_id`, `amount`) — not wrapped in an envelope.

The trailing path segment (e.g. `/credit_type_package/{id}/1`) sets the data-detail level; it is optional for this entity and does not change the returned record.

If the id does not exist, the endpoint currently responds with HTTP `500` and a plain-text `error happened` body (not JSON). Confirm the id exists (e.g. via the list endpoint) before fetching.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The package credit type id to fetch.

amount.description: Credit amount granted for the package (decimal).

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or expired. A caller who is authenticated but lacks view permission for this entity also receives a `401` with a message stating access is not allowed.

500.description: Currently returned when the id does not exist or cannot be loaded — a plain-text `error happened` body. Check the id exists (e.g. via the list endpoint) before fetching.
